_comment: What version this copy is. The same file on GitHub is what an update check compares against, so the two are always the same shape. Bump it in the commit that releases, and add the matching section to CHANGELOG.md. Three other places carry this number too -- .claude-plugin/plugin.json, the marketplace entry beside it, and the git tag -- and 'claude plugin tag' checks that they agree.
_headline: One sentence, spoken aloud when an update is found. Write it for the ear.
headline: On the graphics card she can be told how to say a line, not just what to say -- slowly and sadly, or quick and delighted.
_notes: The two or three things worth hearing about this release. The full account lives in CHANGELOG.md.
notes: Qwen takes a second string beside the words. POST /speak carries it as "instruction", and it steers delivery without changing a word that is read.
The panel shows the mood a line was given -- under the words while it plays, and in a column of its own in the queue and the history. The typing box has a field for trying one by hand.

The field was in the parameter block all along, mapped from Studio and passed as null since the day it was mapped. It is read: the engine tokenizes it into the prefill, and the same sentence runs 5.74 seconds told to be slow and sad against 3.88 told to be quick and excited.
Pocket has no such field and is never sent one, so nothing about the processor engine changes.

Swapping to the processor engine and back used to leave the graphics one dead until the whole server was restarted -- one Java machine per process, and it refused to make a second. It joins the one already there now.
_needsSetup: true when a release changes the slash command, the hooks or the notes -- the parts a pull alone does not reinstall.
